question_text: Explain how transaction isolation can protect a payroll record while one user updates hours and another reads it.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: The update is performed within a transaction.; Other users must not see a partially applied update.; A suitable locking/version mechanism presents a consistent record or delays access.; Commit exposes the completed state; rollback restores the previous valid state after failure.
